# 召唤师主城 · The Conjurer's Main City (temporary directory)

> conjurer.us is the hub (temporary directory for now). Three buildings are open: the arsenal in the OS, the strategy in Agent, the styles in Design.
> 主城是总目录（目前为临时目录）：武在 OS，策略在 Agent，设计在 Design。

## Buildings (open now)

- [Conjurer OS 召唤师硅基法典（武/工具与系统，六个月真传）](https://os.conjurer.us/): The six-month transmission: atlas, alchemy furnace, delusion mirror, spirit compass.
- [B2A 战略统帅部 B2A Strategy Command（卖给 agent 的战略页）](https://agent.conjurer.us/): Four domains, SWOT, four phases, knowledge bridge. All crawler technology lives here.
- [设计风格收集 Design Styles（设计相关看这边）](https://design.conjurer.us/): Eight top-site styles with how-to takeaways and 10 links worth saving. All design reference lives here.

## Also in the city (their own domains)

- [Conjurer Lab 召唤师实验室 (文/思想，Human OS 文章）](https://conjurerlab.com/): Human OS essays: thinking and making, side by side with AI.
- [AI 学习地图册 AI Learning Atlas（六个月路线）](https://aisummoner.com/atlas): One map, four zoom levels, six months end to end.
- [为魔法续杯 Refill the Magic](https://buy.stripe.com/aFadRac4QgOF1zE56jdfG00): Voluntary contributions from readers, any amount from $1.
